## Question and finding

State the question, baseline, measured finding, and the decision it supports.
Say when the result is inconclusive.

## Related issue

Closes #ISSUE or Refs #ISSUE.

## Reproduction and evidence

Identify corpus/query selection, model or cache, device, runtime versions, exact
command, and artifact references. Report correctness checks, quality, timing,
and sample counts under comparable workloads. Include only sanitized output.

## Limitations

Distinguish synthetic and real-model evidence. State sample limits, missing
comparisons, variance, and conclusions the measurements cannot support.
